releases.name: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve
releases.summary:
Step into the cockpit and take flight as an elite pilot across stunning skies. Enter intense dogfights, eliminate threats, and rise through gripping missions to earn your wings.

Campaign Mode showcases stunning visuals with dynamic multi-layered cloudscapes that capture the majesty of living skies. Feel the rush of a fast-paced arcade-style gameplay and deploy powerful weapons to dominate the battlefield.

Beyond the chaos in the air, breathtaking first-person scenes reveal your pilot’s story through breathtaking cinematics. Experience the pressure of command, the weight of decisions, and the bonds forged in battle. Between missions, bond with your squad members, rise to meet adversity, and prove yourself as a true ace.

releases.name: Mister Scary - Where Are You?
releases.summary: Help Mister Scary find his missing family in a spooky retro platforming adventure filled with monsters, bosses, secrets, and Halloween fun!

releases.name: Rooms
releases.summary: Rooms is an atmospheric first-person horror game in which an abandoned, dilapidated house becomes a puzzle in its own right. Search dark rooms, examine mysterious objects and solve mechanical and logical challenges to uncover the way to the final exit. Every door you open leads deeper into an interconnected labyrinth of clues, keys and hidden dangers.But you are not alone. The Gazer forces you to look darkness straight in the face, the Linger makes even safe hiding places more dangerous with every passing second, and the Harrow announces its deadly hunt with flickering lights and a rapidly approaching rumble. To survive, you must listen, understand the warning signs and act at the right moment.In Puzzle Mode, you enter different rooms and must solve the puzzles within them to progress. In Endless Mode, the house rearranges itself for every attempt: 100 rooms, wrong turns, stairs, brief interruptions involving keys and power, and an invisible presence that punishes slow progress. The timer runs until the final door, and your personal best time is saved.

releases.name: HAMVENTURE
releases.summary:
Hamventure is a platformer featuring creative puzzles and engaging challenges. Guide a small pig through 40 levels, overcoming traps such as spikes, saws, and arrows that react to your movements.
Each level introduces new situations that will make you think before taking your first jump.

releases.name: Monster Nursery
releases.summary: A relaxing idle monster collection game (with offline progress). Features 200 monster entries and 29 Lo-fi tracks.

releases.name: Ace Combat Zero: The Belkan War
releases.summary: Ace Combat Zero: The Belkan War thrusts players back in time, 15 years before the events of "Ace Combat 5," and reveals the events that led up to the last chapter of the franchise. Players will take on the role of a mercenary hired to fly for Ustio, a small country bordering Belka, and face off against rival pilots throughout the game. Ace Combat Zero: The Belkan War introduces rival pilots to the series' traditional dogfighting action. Players will encounter highly skilled enemy pilots that they will engage throughout the course of the story. Adding even more tension to the game's dramatic air battles, these rival pilots utilize advanced battle tactics to attack the player while directing their own squadron. [Namco]

releases.name: Crazy Balloon (1980)
releases.summary: Guide a swaying balloon through a thorny maze and attempt to reach the goal while avoiding traps such as moving thorns, scrolling mazes and more.

releases.name: Heartworm
releases.summary:
Sam, unable to move on from the death of her beloved grandfather, falls down an internet rabbit hole chasing the promise of reuniting with him. 

Following the lead of a mysterious forum, she finds herself at a supposedly supernatural house in the mountain, hoping to make contact with the other side.

Pass through the threshold and enter a world born of memories. Defend yourself with a camera while solving death’s mysteries in a reverent evolution of 90’s survival horror, integrating both fixed cameras and over the shoulder perspectives.

releases.name: MXGP 26: The Official Game
releases.summary:
Play as your favorite riders and race on all 20 official tracks of the season in the MXGP and MX2 categories. Every turn, every jump, and every section of the track has been recreated with unparalleled fidelity to transport you to the heart of the official season.

Perfect your scrubs and whips freely in the Compound or chase the hot lap in Time Trial. Feeling competitive? Nail the holeshot in a Quick Race against a grid of 20 wild riders and fight to keep your position over longer or shorter heats. Live the season of your dreams and claim the red plate in Championship mode.

Finally, when the gate drops in Online Multiplayer, show the world who the best rider on the planet is with a global ranking.

releases.name: End of Abyss
releases.summary:
In the depths of a mysterious underground compound, a mission to investigate disturbances of unknown origin spirals into a harrowing descent through a broken and abandoned world. Play as the young combat technician, Cel, as she uncovers the truth behind the facility’s derelict areas and confronts the monstrous creatures that roam them.

Descend into the halls of a sprawling complex, where broken machines whisper to you from the depths, and nothing you encounter is fully human.

Outmatched by the twisted horrors you face, you must upgrade your gear and adapt, pushing your limits just to stay alive against the crushing pressure of the facility you’re trapped within.

Navigate branching paths and uncover hidden areas using your Scanner and the tools you unlock along the way. Pathways open as you grow stronger, allowing you to return to forgotten corridors and secrets once sealed away.

releases.name: Retrospace
releases.summary: Immersive, disco-punk, space horror where you can be a sneaky chap or a mutant action hero as you try to survive on a space station swallowed by a black hole. A mind-bending ride with weird creatures, immersive features, time jumps, and '70s mustaches!

releases.name: PUCKOFF: RELOADED
releases.summary: PUCKOFF: RELOADED is the latest, and greatest, version of the (in)famous game, PUCKOFF, previously available only for personal computers. Enter the world of no-rules hockey as a total newbie and work on your skills and attitude to meet with the mythical terrorizer, Dominator. Build your team of has-beens and legends while learning different playstyles to defeat a plethora of colorful characters around the globe. Team up with the ever cheerful Sarah, the best beer-league goalie Eddie, and the ever grumpy seen-it-all Coach. So grab you skates and PUCK OFF!

releases.name: The Backrooms: Forsaken
releases.summary: What would you do if you were trapped in a dimension of seemingly endless rooms that went on for eternity?

releases.name: Muchi Muchi Pork! & PinkSweets Boosted
releases.summary:
Hardcore yet cute Danmaku shooting makes a grand comeback!

    Muchi Muchi Pork! – Ride rogue machines and turn all of humanity into pigs!
    PinkSweets: Ibara Sorekara – Sisters charge into battle to rescue their mother imprisoned on a remote island.

Two of the most unique titles in CAVE’s legendary shoot-’em-up lineup are back.

Master Various Versions and Game Modes Across Both Titles

    Muchi Muchi Pork! – Rogue machines run wild on Earth! Turn humans into pigs one after another! Blast through enemies and use the massive “Lard Attack” to rack up a mountain of score items!
        Included Variations and Game Modes
            Version 1.0 – The original version that debuted in arcades.
            Version 1.01 – A balanced mode with buffed player ships for a more accessible experience.
            Arrange Mode – Trigger “Fever Mode” with Lard Attacks! Fill the entire screen with score items.
            MANPUKU Mode – A high-difficulty mode featuring “Revenge Fire” (suicide bullets).
            HARAHARA Mode – Start the game directly from the increased difficulty of the 2nd Loop.
    PinkSweets: Ibara Sorekara – Rescue Mom from a forced marriage! The five sisters launch a massive assault on the wedding venue. Block enemy fire with your Shield, then unleash the “Rose Cracker” after charging to wipe out both enemies and bullets!
        Included Variations and Game Modes
            Version 1.0 – The original version that debuted in arcades.
            Version 1.01 – A balanced mode with buffed player ships for a more accessible experience.
            Arrange Mode – The new “Hadou Cannon” weapon accelerates the score attack to new heights.
            HARDER Mode – A high-difficulty mode where destroyed enemies release massive amounts of Revenge Fire.
            EXTENDED Mode – An ultra-hard mode with increased 1st Loop difficulty and access to the 2nd Loop.
            S-ATTACK Mode – A score attack mode where you play Stage 6 with infinite lives and a strict time limit.

All-New Arrangements! “Boosted” with Rich Options

Featuring a completely new arranged background music soundtrack. Switch between the original and arranged tracks to create your own custom setlist!

Featured composers include Daisuke Matsumoto, Yosuke Yasui, Hagane, Sean Bialo.

Also supports Online Rankings and Replay Data recording, allowing you to save and share your best.

releases.name: Chack'n Pop
releases.summary: Chack 'N Pop was released by Taito in 1983. A platform game in which a round yellow creature uses bombs to release the encaged hearts taken from him and his love, so he can go to the next level.

releases.name: Dynasty Warriors 3 Complete Edition Remastered
releases.summary: Dynasty Warriors 3: Complete Edition Remastered is a striking modern revival of Dynasty Warriors 3 and Dynasty Warriors 3: Xtreme Legends, which established the foundation of the entire series for decades to come. Dynasty Warriors 3 was the first game in the Dynasty Warriors series to feature mechanics that would become a mainstay for the series, such as True Musou Attacks, two-player simultaneous play, and the officer development system. It was also the first game in the series to sell more than one million copies. While reproducing the movements of the original game, the action system of Dynasty Warriors 3 has evolved to be more brilliant and exhilarating. In Dynasty Warriors 3: Complete Edition Remastered, players can experience 1 vs. 1,000 action woven by tradition and evolution. In addition, the complete cast of more than 40 officers and numerous battlefields originally featured in the game will be beautifully recreated using Unreal Engine 5, offering peak action and tactical warfare in this thrilling revival. The Dynasty Warriors 3: Xtreme Legends expansion, which is also included, features additional stories for seven officers, including Lu Bu, Meng Huo, and Yuan Shao, as well as bodyguard customization, new weapons, and four types of challenge modes, providing even more gameplay to enjoy in this newly remastered classic. [Koei Tecmo]

releases.name: Shikaku Room
releases.summary:
Shikaku Room is a calm, logic-based puzzle game about dividing space with care.

Each puzzle gives you a grid filled with scattered numbers. Your task is to divide the entire board into rectangles, making sure each rectangle contains exactly one number and covers exactly that many squares. A clue marked 6, for example, must belong to a rectangle made of 6 grid squares.

The rules are simple, but the puzzles quickly become deeply satisfying. Every board is solved through deduction, planning, and a little spatial intuition. There are no timers forcing you forward, no noisy distractions, and no pressure. Just a quiet room, a clean puzzle, and the pleasure of finding the right shape.

Start with small tutorial grids, then work your way through larger and more challenging puzzles as the campaign expands. Shikaku Room is designed for both quick relaxed sessions and longer, thoughtful puzzle-solving.

Features
Elegant rectangle-based logic puzzles
Simple rules with satisfying depth
Calm, minimalist presentation
Progressive campaign difficulty
Small beginner puzzles through to large expert boards
Supports keyboard, mouse, and gamepad controls
Optional hints when you need a gentle nudge
Built-in achievements for progression and mastery
No fast reactions required, only clear thinking
How to Play

Divide the whole grid into rectangles or squares.

Each region must:

Contain exactly one number
Cover exactly the number of squares shown
Avoid overlapping other regions
Leave no empty cells behind

For example, a clue of 12 could be solved as a 3x4 rectangle, a 2x6 rectangle, a 1x12 line, or any other rectangle with an area of 12, as long as it fits the board and does not capture another clue.

Controls

Play comfortably with mouse, keyboard, or gamepad.

Use the cursor to choose a starting cell, expand your rectangle, then confirm your selection. You can cancel, clear a region, or use a hint whenever you need one.

Difficulty

Shikaku Room gradually introduces larger and more complex puzzles:

Novice
Small tutorial boards for learning the rules.

Intermediate
Larger puzzles that require more careful deduction.

Advanced
Wider boards with more possibilities to consider.

Expert
Challenging puzzles for confident players.

Master
Large campaign boards designed for serious Shikaku solvers.

Achievements

Earn achievements as you progress through the campaign and prove your mastery by solving cleanly without relying on hints or mistakes.

releases.name: Storebound
releases.summary:
A 1-3 co-op horror game. Play as ordinary shoppers trapped in an accursed megastore. Find the exit together at all costs before the employees catch you.

Find your way through a shopping complex that was never meant for you.

During opening hours, lights flicker across deserted halls, inviting exploration. When closing time comes, employees roam the aisles looking to "assist" you. Silence, teamwork, and quick thinking are your only tools for survival.

releases.name: Rain Station Z
releases.summary: Multiplayer Open World Zombie Survival

releases.name: Moros Protocol
releases.summary: Face the darkness in Moros Protocol, a pixel-painted sci-fi FPS roguelite where every battle is for survival. Stranded on a decaying warship, stalked by horrors, and guided by a voice you don't recognize, you must adapt, upgrade and push forward. You may be outnumbered, but you are not outmatched.

releases.name: TOYCRAFTER
releases.summary:
You were once a dedicated toycrafter, spending hours working alone in your workshop. But recently you lost your passion for your trade. 

Working on small toys no longer satisfies you. You shifted your focus towards something more grand, more robust.

Cut, paint and attach doll parts to build unique and unsettling sculptures. Ignore any anomalies you see or hear.

releases.name: Anvil Saga
releases.summary:
Anvil Saga is a management sim with RPG elements where you take control of a blacksmith shop amidst the Hundred Years' War. Each decision you make impacts the story and gameplay.

Deal with local bandits, merchants, priests, as well as French and English soldiers. Manage workers with various quirks, improve facilities and tools to create better merchandise, decorate your smithy to attract high-paying customers and most importantly - try not to get yourself beheaded!

releases.name: Balloon Bomber
releases.summary:
"BALLOON BOMBER" is a shooting game released by TAITO in 1980.
Control the anti-aircraft gun and destroy the balloon bombs as they gently sway through the air.
However, destroying the balloon bombs is no easy task. Aim and shoot so your bullets hit only the bomb itself.
If your shot hits the balloon instead, the bomb will fall and blow a hole in the ground. Be careful, as the anti-aircraft gun cannot pass over holes, narrowing your movement range.

releases.name: Seek
releases.summary:
In this unique survival horror game, classical music intertwines with psychological terror to create an oppressive, chilling atmosphere. You play Alice, an ordinary girl who wakes up to find herself trapped in a bizarre, ever-changing world. A snowbound orphanage, monsters lurking in the shadows, and intricate puzzles—every step is fraught with danger and uncertainty.

To survive, you must gather supplies, evade pursuit, and uncover the secrets hidden in the darkness. But as the truth gradually comes to light, can you bear the cruel reality behind it all?

Gameplay features:
Action Shooting
Use a variety of firearms to defeat enemies

Map Exploration
Explore the eerie orphanage step by step, collecting items to unlock new areas while confronting unexplained changes that may occur without warning

Resource Management
Gather and make prudent use of limited resources, and do whatever it takes to survive

Puzzle Solving
Gather clues, solve a wide range of puzzles, and uncover the final truth
